title: 第23章 请客第24章 吃吃喝喝
lines: 第23章请客
“上回邹玲给咱们介绍了那么笔好生意，还没谢她呢，要不，你问问她哪天有空，就请到家里，让老米用心好好做一顿，对了，她喜欢吃什么？”盛夏主意定了，立刻行动。
这会儿，通往卫桓最方便的路，就是邹玲了。
“你想把那东西偷回来？”周凯会错意了，两眼亮闪，“邹玲这个客户，明显的人傻钱多，不过最好等等，咱们刚跟她竞过价，立刻就动手，嫌疑太大。”
“你想哪儿去了。”
盛夏暗暗叹了口气，她不是不想偷，可那个卫桓，明显是个偷不得的。
“那个东西，没什么大不了的，我就是一眼看过去挺喜欢的，可没喜欢到非它不可。我早就想好好请邹玲吃顿饭了，再送份厚礼，以后还指着她介绍生意呢。”
“这倒是，虽说邹玲跟我关系不错，不过，情份这东西，也是个能坐吃山空的。”周凯虽说心里还是有几分疑惑，不过盛夏想跟邹玲拉近关系这一条，他是不怀疑的。
“对了，你跟邹玲怎么认识的？酒吧？一夜情？”盛夏和周凯信步往回走，长路无聊，正好问问。
“跟邹玲一夜情？就她那样的？小夏啊，你不相信我的人品，但你不能怀疑我的品味。”
“这句话得告诉邹玲。”盛夏竖起一根指头。
“邹玲现在，比年青的时候，好看多了。”周凯摊了下手，表示不在乎，“她上次说过一句，她和白巧，都是光着脚从穷困极了走出来的，白巧是不是我不知道，她肯定是。”
经过个烤红薯的小摊，盛夏买了一只，从口袋里摸了只小巧的小勺子出来，边走边吃边听周凯说邹玲的过往。
“邹玲是长姐，还有两个妹妹，说是还有一个妹妹，一生下来，被她爹溺死了，好象……”
周凯皱着眉头想了想，顺便从盛夏手里抢过勺子吃了口烤红薯。
“总之她爹跟她妈离婚了，离婚的原因，她没说清楚，大概既有溺死这个妹妹的原因，也有她爹嫌她妈只会生闺女的原因。她们娘四个过的挺苦，邹玲和她两个妹妹，个个学习都好的不得了，穷人家孩子懂事嘛，后来邹玲考进了国立大学法律系。”
盛夏低低吹了声口哨，国立大学法律系可不是一般的难考。
“她毕业前一年，到一家律所实习，国立大学的学生么，去实习的，当然都是有名的大律所，那年她妈病重住院，说是尿毒症，非常严重了，要换肾，她想钱想疯了，有个案子，对方给了她一笔钱，要她复印一份卷宗，她就……”
周凯摊了摊手，“当时我正好因为我父亲的事，也委托在那家律师事务所，那家律所的一个合伙人，跟我父亲是发小，我当时，还比较有温度有热血啊什么的，就替她还了那笔钱，那位伯伯也觉得邹玲本性不坏，帮了很大的忙，这事，就算替她抹过去了。”
“那她妈妈？”盛夏主动将勺子递给周凯。
“邹玲今年都四十出头了，那时候她还不到二十岁，二十年前的医疗水平，那笔钱没用完，人就死了，我陪她回去料理的后事，家里是真穷。回来后我又给了她一点钱，就出国了，她后来一边在那家律所打工，一边读到了博士，就这样。“
“那邹玲两个妹妹呢？”盛夏想着周凯那句，个个学习都好的不得了。
“不知道，我就是偶尔热血了一回，哪有功夫管什么妹妹弟弟的。这个天吃羊肉最好，晚上吃羊肉锅子吧？”周凯随口应了句，就岔开了话题。
“嗯，你给邹玲打个电话吧，问问她什么时候有空，把宋词也叫过来，让老常烤个全羊，人少了吃不了。”盛夏将吃空了的烤红薯皮丢进垃圾桶里。
“让她回电话，她是个忙人，经常不方便接电话。”周凯摸出手机，飞快的按键发信息。
邹玲和黄云生办了手续拿上那只破烂的碧玉莲，黄云生一把抢过捧在手心里，紧跟着邹玲出来，上车回去环贸大厦。
从专用电梯进到卫桓办公室，黄云生哈着腰，一脸谄笑，小步紧趋将放着碧玉莲的小盒子放到卫桓桌子上，再哈着腰退到邹玲侧后，垂手垂头恭敬站好。
邹玲无语的看着黄云生，看他这样子，活脱脱就是电视里的最反面的那个狗腿子太监。
“价钱抬到了一千万零五千。”邹玲干脆直接的说正事。
卫桓眉梢往上扬了扬。
邹玲看着他扬起的眉梢，沉着解释，“有个四十九号，一直紧盯不放，抬到五十万时，我就给您打过电话，您没接，发了信息，您也没回，抬到一百万时，又打过电话，打了十几通电话，您一直没接。因为您没有限定最高价，电话又没能打通，我没敢放手。”。
卫桓打开盒子，拿出那只碧玉莲，托在手心里看了看，放到桌面上，看着邹玲道：“以后有类似限定最高价什么的，你记得提醒我。”
“好。”邹玲噎了口气。
难道他连这个基本常识也不知道？
看来这一千万就是当了回冤大头。
这事跟周凯有没有关系？
邹玲一个转身的功夫，想了一堆的可能性。
看着邹玲出去了，黄云生连哈了几下腰，“老板，跟咱们抢东西的那个，就是上次死活不卖给咱们青铜疙瘩的那个盛夏，就是那个狐狸精的外甥女。”
卫桓正要捏起碧玉莲的手，僵住了。
（本章完）

Chapter 23 Treat
"Last time, Zou Ling introduced us to such a good business, but I haven't thanked her yet. How about asking her when she is free, invite her to your home, and let Lao Mi cook a good meal with all her heart. By the way, what does she like to eat?" Shengxia made up her mind and acted immediately.
At this moment, the most convenient way to Wei Huan is Zou Ling.
"You want to steal that thing back?" Zhou Kaihui got it wrong, his eyes sparkling, "Zou Ling, this customer, is obviously stupid and has a lot of money, but it's best to wait. We just made a bid with her and we acted immediately. It's too suspicious."
"Where are you thinking?"
Shengxia secretly sighed. It wasn't that she didn't want to steal, but Wei Huan was obviously someone who couldn't steal.
"That thing, it's not a big deal. I just liked it at first sight, but I didn't like it enough to insist on it. I have long wanted to treat Zou Ling to a nice meal, give her a generous gift, and introduce business to her in the future."
"That's true. Although Zou Ling has a good relationship with me, love is something that can only be taken advantage of." Although Zhou Kai still had some doubts in his heart, he had no doubt that Sheng Xia wanted to get closer to Zou Ling.
"By the way, how did you and Zou Ling meet? Bar? One-night stand?" Sheng Xia and Zhou Kai strolled back. They were bored after a long walk, so they just asked.
"A one-night stand with Zou Ling? Is she like that? Xiaoxia, you don't believe in my character, but you can't doubt my taste."
"You have to tell Zou Ling about this." Shengxia raised a finger.
"Zou Ling is much prettier now than when she was young." Zhou Kai spread his hands and said he didn't care, "She said last time that she and Bai Qiao both came out of poverty barefoot. I don't know if Bai Qiao is the same, but she must be."
Passing by a stall selling roasted sweet potatoes, Shengxia bought one, took out a small spoon from his pocket, and ate while walking while listening to Zhou Kai talk about Zou Ling's past.
"Zou Ling is the eldest sister, and she has two younger sisters. It is said that there is another younger sister who was drowned by her father when she was born. It seems..."
Zhou Kai frowned and thought for a while, then grabbed the spoon from Sheng Xia's hand and took a bite of the roasted sweet potato.
"Anyway, her father and her mother divorced. She didn't explain the reason for the divorce clearly. It was probably because she drowned the younger sister, and also because her father thought her mother would only have girls. The four of them lived a very hard life. Zou Ling and her two younger sisters were all very good at studies. Children from poor families are sensible. Later, Zou Ling was admitted to the law department of the National University."
Sheng Xia whistled lowly, the National University Law Department was not an ordinary difficult test.
"The year before she graduated, she went to a law firm for an internship. She was a student from a national university. Of course, all the internships were at famous big law firms. That year, her mother was seriously ill and was hospitalized. It was said that she had uremia, which was very serious. She needed a kidney transplant. She was crazy about money. There was a case, and the other party gave her a sum of money and asked her to make a copy of the file, so she..."
Zhou Kai spread his hands, "At that time, I entrusted that law firm with my father's affairs. A partner of that law firm grew up with my father. I was relatively warm-blooded and so on at the time, so I paid back the money for her. The uncle also felt that Zou Ling was not a bad person and was a great help. This matter can be wiped out for her."
"What about her mother?" Shengxia took the initiative to hand the spoon to Zhou Kai.
"Zou Ling is in her early 40s this year. At that time, she was not yet 20 years old. With the level of medical care 20 years ago, the person died before the money was used up. I went back with her to take care of the funeral. The family was really poor. After I came back, I gave her some money and went abroad. She later worked in that law firm while studying for a doctorate, and that was it."
"What about Zou Ling's two sisters?" Shengxia thought about Zhou Kai's words, they all studied very well.
"I don't know, I just got excited once in a while, so I don't have time to care about my sisters and brothers. It's best to eat mutton on this day. How about a mutton pot in the evening?" Zhou Kai responded casually and changed the subject.
"Well, you should call Zou Ling and ask her when she is free. Call Song Ci over and ask Lao Chang to roast a whole lamb. There will be too many people to eat." Shengxia threw the eaten roasted sweet potato skins into the trash can.
"Ask her to call her back. She is a busy person and it is often inconvenient to answer the phone." Zhou Kai took out his phone and pressed the buttons quickly to send a message.
……………………
Zou Ling and Huang Yunsheng went through the formalities and took the tattered Jasper Lotus. Huang Yunsheng snatched it and held it in his hand. He followed Zou Ling out and got in the car to go back to the International Trade Building.
Entering Wei Huan's office from the special elevator, Huang Yunsheng hunched over, with a flattering smile on his face, took small steps and put the small box with the jade lotus on Wei Huan's desk, then hunched back to Zou Ling's side, and stood respectfully with his hands lowered and his head lowered.
Zou Ling looked at Huang Yunsheng speechlessly. Looking at him like this, he looked exactly like the most negative eunuch on TV.
"The price has been raised to ten million and five thousand." Zou Ling got down to business directly.
Wei Huan raised his eyebrows.
Zou Ling looked at his raised eyebrows and explained calmly, "There is a number 49, and I have been keeping a close eye on it. When the price reached 500,000, I called you, but you didn't answer. I sent a message, but you didn't reply. When the price reached 1 million, I called again, and made more than a dozen calls, but you never answered. Because you didn't set a maximum price, and the call failed to get through, I didn't dare to let go."
Wei Huan opened the box, took out the jade lotus, held it in his hand, looked at it, put it on the table, looked at Zou Ling and said: "If there is something like a limited maximum price in the future, remember to remind me."
"Okay." Zou Ling choked.
Doesn't he even know this basic common sense?
It seems that the 10 million yuan was taken back from someone who had been taken advantage of.
Does this matter have anything to do with Zhou Kai?
Zou Ling turned around and thought about a bunch of possibilities.
